_comment: The factory's build root: the image every RPM is built against.
Single source of truth; every tool that needs it reads it from here.
It is deliberately the same image the released artifact is built on.
Anything else is a different ABI target, and a package that links
against it does not link against the running system.
JSON rather than YAML so the tools depend only on the standard library.

_comment_digest: A tag alone is not a pin: it means building against whatever the tag
resolved to, which is neither reproducible nor attestable.
_comment_registry_pull_per_job: The build root is pulled once per run and passed between jobs as an
artifact, so every job provably uses the same bytes. On GitHub-hosted
runners the disk budget is 14 GB and seven c10s images is over it, so
this escape hatch exists. It is false by default, which makes using it
a visible choice rather than an accident.
_comment_repositories: CRB ships disabled in c10s and several build roots for this stack live
